text: This website presents the business of Piroliswiss S.R.L.: production and export of charcoal and pyrolysis by-products. The information published is indicative; specifications, volumes and commercial terms are confirmed in each quote.

sections.title: Controller
text: Piroliswiss S.R.L. by Grupo Zwald S.R.L., Calle Clara 2885, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. Contact: office@piroliswiss.com.

sections.title: What data we process
text: The data you send us through the contact form: company, country, email, product, volume, Incoterm and message.
The server also technically records the IP address of each submission, only for security and to prevent abuse.

sections.title: What we use it for
text: To answer your request, prepare quotes and manage the business relationship that follows. We do not send advertising without your consent and we do not sell or share your data.

sections.title: Who receives it
text: Our sales team. Also the technical providers that host this website and our email, solely to provide that service.

sections.title: How long we keep it
text: For as long as needed to handle your request and the resulting business relationship, and afterwards for the periods required by law.

sections.title: Cookies
text: We use Google Analytics (Google LLC) to measure visits in aggregate: pages viewed, approximate country and city, where the visit came from and device type. Analytics cookies are only set if you accept them in the cookie notice.

If you decline, Google Analytics stores no cookies on your device and only receives anonymous signals without identifiers. We use no advertising cookies. You can change your choice by clearing this site's data in your browser.

sections.title: Your rights
text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its processing, by writing to office@piroliswiss.com.
